title: Build-review verdict record
description: One independent review of one phase's diff: one file under <docs_root>/reviews/, named <verdict_id>.json. The session that ran the review writes it from the reviewer's reply without changing a finding and commits it on the phase's control branch. Every field except outcomes is fixed once committed; outcomes are only ever appended.

verdict_id.description: The file's name without .json: the review date, the phase id, then the reviewer type; a second review the same day by the same type adds a counter.

phase.description: The phase id, or agent/<slug> for unclaimed work.

repository.description: Which repository's diff the review judged.

reviewed_commit.description: The full commit the review judged.

reviewer.description: The dedicated reviewer agent that ran the review.

definition_sha256.description: sha256 of the agent definition file the reviewer ran with, so a later change to it is visible against its verdicts.

model.description: The model the reviewer ran on, as the dispatch reported it.

verdict.description: pass=the phase may merge, with or without findings | reject=it may not merge as it stands.

gating.description: true=this verdict decided the merge | false=it ran in shadow and decided nothing.

findings.description: Every finding in the reviewer's reply, as written. Empty when it found nothing.

id.description: Unique within the record: F01, F02 and so on.

severity.description: How much the defect matters to the merge.

evidence.description: What the reviewer checked to establish it: a file and line, or a command and its output.

consequence.description: What goes wrong if it stands. Optional.

disposition.description: Fixed (naming the change) or accepted (naming who accepted it). Added before the merge.

outcomes.description: What was learned about the verdict afterwards, oldest first; only ever appended.

kind.description: What kind of later evidence this is.

recorded_by.description: Who recorded it: a developer handle or agent id.

notes.description: Anything a reader needs that no other field holds. Optional.
